verdict.rationale: Temporal's server lives in a public GitHub repository (temporalio/temporal), and the evidence shows it is a fork of Uber's Cadence that can be self-hosted, so its source is readable. However, no evidence item names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the license (e.g., MIT/Apache) and corroboration that SDKs and other components are also openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
